line: If he a dog, then we China
vault_lines: If he a dog, then we China
meaning: Sosa is referencing the stereotype of Chinese people eating dogs. By calling his crew China, and the opposition a dog, he suggests that his gang is superior.

line: Shit brazy (Shit brazy), shit crazy (Shit crazy) I lost a lot of niggas, thank God I still made it
vault_lines: I lost a lot of niggas, thank God I still made it
meaning:
Referring to the amount of family members and friends he’s lost over the past few years, Reese pays homage to them by shouting them out mid verse.

Being the religious man he is, he also thanks God for still being here among us. He’s surprised that all of the crazy things he’s done thus far in life haven’t gotten him killed.

line: Shit brazy, please don’t try to play me (Nah)
vault_lines: Shit brazy, please don't try to play me (Nah)
meaning: In other words, disrespect Reese or any of his squad and they’ll go “brazy” on you. The “C” in “crazy” usually is replaced by a “B” only when the individual speaking is a part of gang life. Specifically the Bloods, when talking they noticeably pronounce all of their C’s as B’s.

line: [Intro: Chief Keef] GGP Ayy (GGP) Bang, bang, gang, gang Bang, bang, gang, gang Bang, nigga Gang, nigga
vault_lines: Bang, bang, gang, gang
meaning: Chief Sosa’s legendary entrance to the majority of the tracks he’s featured on. Usually always including the words “bang”, “gang”, “300”, etc. He’s always been known to have an abundance of ad-libs featured within his music.

line: Shit brazy, shit crazy My wrist crazy, my bitch crazy My bitch brazy, my wrist brazy My neck brazy, my gear brazy Brazy, brazy, brazy Brazy, brazy, brazy Crazy, crazy, crazy, crazy Crazy, crazy, crazy, crazy
vault_lines: Crazy, crazy, crazy, crazy
meaning:
Originally said on the track “Change Up”, which is also featured on Reese’s Supa Savage 2:

And that block I come from I swear we wouldn’t change nothin'
Just young hot heads who don’t really give a fuck

Chief Sosa knows more than anybody that him and his squad can get out of hand at times. When they turn up they act insane and go all out. In this case, when he refers to something he owns as “crazy”, he means it’s top tier. He’s got the nicest watches, chains, women, etc. He loves bragging about his materialistic possessions.
